scope.description: Current published credit-vault cohort; excludes index wrappers, private facilities and unlisted siblings. Each facility enters coverage at its first indexed snapshot.

methodology.creditExtended: Latest reported cumulative epoch credit per vault by observation block timestamp. Cumulative epoch values are never summed across cycles or backdated to their start dates.
methodology.tvl: Latest indexed withRequestsUSD, falling back to USD only when the extended field is absent; six USD base-unit decimals. May include idle capital, retained interest and pending withdrawal cash. This is not borrower debt.
methodology.observations: UTC daily last indexed snapshots on dates with source observations. Last reported values carry forward between index updates. A vault contributes zero before its first indexed snapshot; missing reported amounts remain gaps.
